rationale: The closing-line research (research/game_model, research/market_prior) established that a team-level EPA football model is redundant to the CLOSE: encompassing coefficient ~0 on the model, optimal blend weight 0. That result says nothing about the market at T-24h, T-6h, T-90m or T-30m, which is where the shadow pricer actually acts. Football information the market has not yet incorporated at an earlier horizon would show up as a challenger centre that (a) is closer to the realised margin/total than the snapshot market centre and (b) points toward where the market eventually closes. The three arms isolate the CENTRE as the only thing that changes: CURRENT_MARKET_PRIOR (the incumbent, market-implied centre), DATA_ONLY (the frozen football-only centre, no same-game market input), and HYBRID_30_DATA (0.70 x market centre + 0.30 x football centre), all pushed through the SAME residual-bank simulation on common random numbers and priced on the SAME contracts at the SAME instant.
features: DATA_ONLY: opponent-adjusted ridge team ratings on eleven play-by-play metrics from games final before the snapshot, matchup differences and sums, rest difference, divisional game, neutral site, indoor; ridge margin and total models frozen on seasons 2018-2025 (research/three_arm/data_only_artifact_2026.json, sha e544b99917b9d0b1). No spread, total, moneyline, Kalshi price, midpoint, ladder fit, consensus line or any variable containing one (whitelisted design matrix, attested per record, tested). HYBRID_30_DATA: exactly 0.70 * CURRENT centre + 0.30 * DATA_ONLY centre, for margin and for total. CURRENT: the incumbent's centre unchanged.
target: PRIMARY GAME-CENTRE METRICS: margin RMSE and MAE, total RMSE and MAE, paired per game, arm minus CURRENT and arm minus the market centre at the snapshot and at the close. PRIMARY MARKET-PRICING METRICS: paired Brier (binary settlements) and paired payout MSE versus CURRENT and versus the market midpoint at the snapshot, game-clustered; movement toward the eventual close (share of challenger deviations from the snapshot centre that point toward the closing centre). PRIMARY HORIZONS: T-24h, T-6h, T-90m, T-30m, plus latest-pregame; one row per game (or contract) per horizon by the documented selection rule; never raw snapshots.
expected_direction: Prior, from the closing-line research: at the close DATA_ONLY is worse than CURRENT and HYBRID_30 is slightly worse (blend RMSE 12.91 vs 12.88). The open question is whether at T-24h / T-6h the challenger deviations point toward the close more often than not and whether HYBRID_30 is at least not worse than CURRENT there. A DATA_ONLY that beats CURRENT at any horizon would be surprising and would need to survive the full season.
test_plan: PREREGISTERED BEFORE ANY PROSPECTIVE CHALLENGER RECORD EXISTS. Prospective on 2026 three-arm snapshots written by scripts/shadow/three_arm_snapshot.py from the moment this code is merged; every record carries observed_at < kickoff and generated_at < kickoff, enforced in code, schema and tests, and a post-kickoff record is written as POST_KICKOFF_EXCLUDED with no forecast. The already-completed 2026 game(s) before activation (2026_01_NE_SEA) are NOT challenger evidence and can never be inserted. Weights, arms, horizons and metrics are the constants in nfl_edge/arms/registry.py, pinned to this entry by tests/test_three_arm_preregistration.py. No verdict of any kind before 64 distinct games (four full weeks) carry a scored latest-pregame record; until then every report prints INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Uncertainty is clustered at the game. No hybrid-weight grid, no per-game weight, no dynamic weighting, no subgroup search; the disagreement bands are descriptive cuts of one sample. Challenger outcomes cannot modify any weight, feature, threshold or gate automatically; promotion of any arm is a separate, explicit, owner-approved project.
dataset: market-data: data/shadow/arms (immutable three-arm snapshots + funnel), data/shadow/arm_evaluations (immutable evaluations), data/kalshi/capture (closes), nflverse final results; research/three_arm/ for the pre-2026 implementation validation
result: UNTESTED. Historical implementation validation only (research/three_arm/RESULTS.md): the reusable DATA_ONLY reproduces the frozen walk-forward research bit for bit; HYBRID_30 reproduces the research's 0.3-blend RMSE; against the CLOSING consensus line CURRENT remains best, as the research found. No prospective evidence exists yet.
notes: The hybrid weight of 0.30 is a research challenger, not a claim that 0.30 is optimal; the research's blend table showed RMSE rising monotonically with model weight at the close, so 0.30 is a deliberately conservative probe of the earlier horizons. The CURRENT arm inside the comparison harness is the incumbent's centre re-simulated on the shared draws and is checked against the incumbent's own ledger prices at every 2-hourly snapshot (Monte Carlo tolerance); at the four canonical horizons the centre is re-derived with the incumbent's own estimator from the same capture (no ledger snapshot exists then) and the record says so. Player props are instrumented and autopsied separately and are NOT part of this hypothesis.
